lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered arrangement of high-luminance local maxima distributed across the mid-lateral zone, forming a sparse 2D grid with increasing inter-blob distance moving posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of circular blobs, most visible in the central-lateral section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Distinct horizontal linear feature in the superior flank region characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient with high-value pixels above a lower-value shadow region.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of small, low-diameter high-luminance spots concentrated on the leading edge and distal surface of the pectoral fin.
